question:
Identify the correct spelling of the underlined word.

The police issued a __varant__ to the criminals.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"varant"** is misspelled and does not have a meaning in English. (यह अंग्रेजी में कोई अर्थ नहीं रखता)

 
 
• **Example: **The police issued a varant to the criminals. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **"Warrant" **refers to a legal document issued by a court or legal authority authorizing the police to make an arrest, search premises, or carry out some other action relating to the administration of justice. (वारंट)
 
 
• **Example: **The police issued a **warrant** to arrest the suspect.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Varrant** (वैरंट): This is a misspelling and does not have a meaning in English.

 
 
• **Example: **The police issued a varrant to the criminals. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **Warent** (वारेंट): This is a misspelling and does not have a meaning in English.
 
 
• **Example: **The police issued a warent to the criminals. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **Warant** (वारंट): This is a misspelling and does not have a meaning in English.
 
 
• **Example: **The police issued a warant to the criminals. (Incorrect usage)
